strings.text: **Global Studies Diploma** — “the first of its kind in the country”. Begins in 9th grade, requires a world language through all four years, globally-focused coursework, cross-cultural experience, an individual portfolio, and a lengthy research paper in the capstone Global Leadership course. **344 graduates since 2007**, 23 in the Class of 2026 alone.
strings.t: **Global Studies Diploma** — “premye nan kalite l nan peyi a”. Li kòmanse nan 9yèm ane, li egzije yon lang etranje pandan tout kat ane, kou ki konsantre sou mond lan, eksperyans ant kilti, yon pòtfèy endividyèl, ak yon long papye rechèch nan kou kapston Global Leadership la. **344 gradye depi 2007**, 23 nan sèl Klas 2026 la.

strings.text: **Diploma in Entrepreneurial Studies** — new for 2026, sitting inside IDEAS@PD (Innovation, Design, Entrepreneurship, Analytics, Sustainability) with industry-certification opportunities and business partnerships.

strings.text: **Required 30-hour Senior Project internship** — a graduation requirement, so every graduate leaves with a documented experiential credential. Notably the school has *no* community-service requirement, deliberately.
strings.t: **Estaj Senior Project 30 èdtan obligatwa** — yon kondisyon pou gradye, kidonk chak gradye pati ak yon kalifikasyon eksperyansyèl ki dokimante. Sa ki remakab, lekòl la *pa gen* okenn kondisyon sèvis kominotè, espre.

strings.text: **Recruiting & arts tracks** — “Facts About Athletic Recruiting” and “Studying the Arts in College” sessions run in alternating years. The Class of 2026 sent 31 student-athletes to college sport, 13 at Division I.
strings.t: **Pis rekritman ak atizay** — sesyon “Facts About Athletic Recruiting” ak “Studying the Arts in College” fèt an altènans chak ane. Klas 2026 la te voye 31 atlèt-elèv nan espò inivèsitè, 13 nan Division I.

strings.text: The Entrepreneurial Studies Diploma is announced but its course requirements, capstone and internship structure are not published — inquiries are directed to an email address. Compare Global Studies, which publishes both requirements and a 344-graduate throughput.
strings.t: Yo anonse Diplòm Entrepreneurial Studies la men kondisyon kou li yo, kapston an ak estrikti estaj li pa pibliye — yo voye kesyon yo nan yon adrès imèl. Konpare ak Global Studies, ki pibliye ni kondisyon yo ni yon rannman 344 gradye.

strings.text: **The Academic Profile as an instrument** — an unusually disclosive document, and that is the leverage. It volunteers a full per-subject AP distribution across 31 subjects, a quintile table with mean SAT and ACT per fifth, explicit AP-load norms, and the weighting formula with unweighted grades on the transcript. It converts a no-rank policy from a liability into context.
strings.t: **Academic Profile la kòm yon zouti** — yon dokiman ki divilge anpil yon fason ki pa abityèl, epi se sa ki leviye a. Li bay volontèman yon distribisyon AP konplè pa matyè atravè 31 matyè, yon tab senkyèm ak SAT ak ACT mwayèn pa senkyèm, nòm chay AP eksplisit, ak fòmil pwa a ak nòt san pwa sou relve nòt la. Li konvèti yon politik san ran soti nan yon feblès rive nan yon kontèks.

strings.text: **Integrity signalling** — the school states it complies with the **NACAC Guide to Ethical Practice** and “reports all student behavioral probations, suspensions and expulsions through time of graduation” to any college that asks, backed by a student-run Honor Council. strings.text: **Repeat pipelines, numbered rather than implied** — the Class of 2025 scholar was Providence Day’s **18th Morehead-Cain**, a decades-deep pipeline to North Carolina’s most selective merit award. strings.text: **Two-way relationships and memberships** — NAIS, NCAIS, SAIS, ERB, NACAC, SACAC, **ACCIS** and the College Board, accredited by SAIS and SACS, plus Global Online Academy. ~150 reps hosted against 50+ campuses visited is a genuine two-way cadence, and a deep UK/Europe pipeline (Oxford, St Andrews, UCL, LSE, Trinity Dublin, Bocconi, Toronto) matches the Global Studies identity.

strings.text: The jump from 48 AP Scholars with Distinction (2018–20) to 193 (2023–25) is very large. Part is real growth, but the magnitude suggests the counting basis may differ between editions — the school does not define it. Do not present the two as directly comparable.

The window starts at 2023, matching the floor the other schools here share; the school publishes no Class of 2026 acceptance list yet, so the window does not extend that far forward. Note tou ke reklamasyon “100% nan inivèsite kat ane” tout twa edisyon pwofil achive yo te pote a RETIRE nan edisyon aktyèl la, san okenn eksplikasyon, kidonk li pa dwe pote pou klas aktyèl la.

strings.text: Latin’s differentiators are narrow, deep and genuinely elite in two places — a top-20 national debate programme and an MIT-lineage Fab Lab — and the school leaves the assembly of a spike almost entirely to the student.
strings.t: Sa ki fè Latin diferan etwat, pwofon epi vrèman elit nan de kote — yon pwogram deba nan top-20 nasyonal ak yon Fab Lab ki soti nan liyaj MIT — epi lekòl la kite konstriksyon yon espesyalite prèske nèt nan men elèv la.

strings.text: There is no required capstone or senior project that manufactures one, which makes the two flagship programmes carry more weight than they would elsewhere.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn kapston oswa pwojè dènye ane obligatwa ki fabrike youn, sa ki fè de pwogram pòtdrapo yo pote plis pwa pase yo ta genyen lòt kote.

strings.text: **Speech & Debate — the strongest documented spike.** An NSDA **Debate School of Excellence Award**, one of the top 20 programmes in the country; NSDA **charter status**; **200 Club** membership in 2025. Director Bilal Butt has earned a second Diamond award with 30,000+ NSDA points over ten years. At 2025 Nationals, 7 debaters competed and 6 earned recognition against 6,700+ students — including a **5th place in Public Forum**.
strings.t: **Speech & Debate — espesyalite ki pi byen dokimante a.** Yon NSDA **Debate School of Excellence Award**, youn nan top 20 pwogram nan peyi a; **estati chat** NSDA; manbraj **200 Club** an 2025. Direktè Bilal Butt genyen yon dezyèm prim Diamond ak plis pase 30,000 pwen NSDA sou dis ane. Nan Nationals 2025, 7 debatè te konpetisyone epi 6 te genyen rekonesans kont plis pase 6,700 elèv — ki enkli yon **5yèm plas nan Public Forum**.

strings.text: **It is curricular, not merely a club.** The courses carry a competition mandate: the intro course requires participation in two tournaments a year, and the advanced course requires six.
strings.t: **Li kourikoulè, se pa senpleman yon klib.** Kou yo pote yon mandat konpetisyon: kou entwodiksyon an egzije patisipasyon nan de tounwa pa ane, epi kou avanse a egzije sis.

strings.text: **Innovation & Design / Fab Lab** — an official Fab Lab school in the lineage of **MIT’s Center for Bits and Atoms**, and an active Fab Academy node since 2016. Engineering has been taught here since 1989; the lab runs 3D printing, CNC milling, circuit production, laser and precision milling. Upper School courses are taught “like a professional software engineering firm”, with students presenting to external panels of industry experts.
strings.t: **Innovation & Design / Fab Lab** — yon lekòl Fab Lab ofisyèl nan liyaj **Center for Bits and Atoms MIT la**, epi yon nœud Fab Academy aktif depi 2016. Yo anseye enjenyri isit la depi 1989; laboratwa a fè enprime 3D, fresaj CNC, pwodiksyon sikwi, koupe ak lazè ak fresaj presi. Kou Upper School yo ansenye “tankou yon konpayi enjenyri lojisyèl pwofesyonèl”, ak elèv k ap prezante devan panèl ekstèn ekspè endistri.

strings.text: **Malone Scholars School** — North Carolina’s only one, endowed by the Malone Family Foundation, which selects 50 independent schools nationally partly for their “excellent accommodations for gifted and talented students”.
strings.t: **Malone Scholars School** — sèl la nan North Carolina, ak dotasyon nan men Malone Family Foundation, ki chwazi 50 lekòl endepandan nan tout peyi a an pati pou “akomodasyon eksèlan yo pou elèv dwe ak talan”.

strings.text: **Internships do exist**, contrary to a common assumption: a **Biomedical Internship Program** placing seniors with Atrium Health is course-embedded in Advanced Topics in Engineering, alongside a Student Internship Program elective.
strings.t: **Estaj egziste vre**, kontrèman ak yon sipozisyon komen: yon **Biomedical Internship Program** ki plase elèv dènye ane ak Atrium Health entegre nan kou Advanced Topics in Engineering, ansanm ak yon elektif Student Internship Program.

strings.text: There is still no required internship, capstone, senior project, independent study or school-wide research requirement — graduation requirements are purely credit-based, and there is no global-studies certificate or diploma. Athletic recruiting and arts-in-college support are informational programmes only: no named recruiting coordinator, highlight-film service, conservatory-prep track or portfolio review is published.
strings.t: Toujou pa gen estaj obligatwa, kapston, pwojè dènye ane, etid endepandan oswa kondisyon rechèch pou tout lekòl la — kondisyon gradyasyon yo se piman kredi, epi pa gen sètifika oswa diplòm nan etid mondyal. Sipò pou rekritman atletik ak atizay nan inivèsite se pwogram enfòmasyon sèlman: pa gen kòdonatè rekritman ki gen non, sèvis fim pwen enpòtan, pis preparasyon pou konsèvatwa oswa revizyon pòtfèy ki pibliye.

strings.text: **The School Profile works against itself.** It is the one document every admissions office reads, and Latin’s current edition omits the grading scale, the weighting statement, the class-rank policy, the CEEB code, the four-year matriculation percentage and all testing data — while carrying an unremoved internal editorial note in the live PDF.
strings.t: **School Profile la travay kont tèt li.** Se sèl dokiman chak biwo admisyon li, epi edisyon aktyèl Latin la kite deyò echèl nòt la, deklarasyon sou pwa a, politik ran nan klas la, kòd CEEB la, pousantaj enskripsyon kat ane a ak tout done tès yo — pandan li pote yon nòt editoryal entèn yo pa retire nan PDF ki an dirèk la.

strings.text: **The integrity block was deleted wholesale.** All three archived editions carried, verbatim: “Reflecting our emphasis on ‘HONOR ABOVE ALL,’ our policy is to report any **probations, suspensions, and expulsions through time of graduation** to any colleges that request this information. CLS complies with the **NACAC Statement of Principles of Good Practice**.” None of that survives into the current profile.
strings.t: **Blòk sou entegrite a te efase nèt.** Tout twa edisyon achive yo te pote, mo pou mo: “Ki reflete aksan nou sou ‘ONÈ ANWO TOUT BAGAY,’ politik nou se rapòte nenpòt **pwobasyon, sispansyon, ak ekspilsyon jiska moman gradyasyon** bay nenpòt inivèsite ki mande enfòmasyon sa a. CLS konfòm ak **NACAC Statement of Principles of Good Practice** la.” Anyen nan sa pa siviv nan pwofil aktyèl la.

strings.text: **Named-scholarship history was deleted too.** The 2017–18 edition told readers the school’s students had won Morehead-Cain, Robertson, B.N. Duke, Jefferson, Belk, Bryan, Chancellor’s, Danforth and Johnson scholarships, and gave application and matriculation breadth. Not one of those sentences survives.
strings.t: **Istwa bous ki gen non yo te efase tou.** Edisyon 2017–18 la te di moun k ap li ke elèv lekòl la te genyen bous Morehead-Cain, Robertson, B.N. Duke, Jefferson, Belk, Bryan, Chancellor’s, Danforth ak Johnson, epi li te bay etandi aplikasyon ak enskripsyon. Pa gen yon sèl nan fraz sa yo ki siviv.

strings.text: **What remains is genuine and external** — the NSDA recognition, the Fab Academy node, and the Malone Family Foundation selection are all third-party validations that do not depend on the profile.
strings.t: **Sa ki rete a otantik epi ekstèn** — rekonesans NSDA a, nœud Fab Academy a, ak seleksyon Malone Family Foundation la tout se validasyon twazyèm pati ki pa depann de pwofil la.

strings.text: The net effect is a school whose real institutional strengths are verifiable elsewhere but are no longer argued for in the document colleges actually read.
strings.t: Rezilta nèt la se yon lekòl ki gen vrè fòs enstitisyonèl ou ka verifye lòt kote men ki pa defann yo ankò nan dokiman inivèsite yo li vre a.

strings.text: An unsourced reference to a 2018 national debate champion surfaced during research but could not be corroborated against speechanddebate.org, so it is deliberately excluded here rather than repeated.
strings.t: Yon referans san sous sou yon chanpyon nasyonal deba 2018 te parèt pandan rechèch la men nou pa t kapab koroboure l kont speechanddebate.org, kidonk nou eskli l espre isit la olye ke repete l.

strings.text: Latin publishes almost no class-level analytics — no SAT, no ACT, no AP score distribution, no GPA distribution, and no rank, quintile or decile table.
strings.t: Latin pibliye prèske okenn analiz nan nivo klas la — pa gen SAT, pa gen ACT, pa gen distribisyon nòt AP, pa gen distribisyon GPA, ak pa gen tab ran, senkyèm oswa dizyèm.

strings.text: The absence is the finding, and it cuts both ways: it protects students in the middle of the class from unflattering comparison, and it removes every quantitative lever a strong student might otherwise use to stand out.
strings.t: Absans lan se konklizyon an, epi li koupe nan de sans: li pwoteje elèv nan mitan klas la kont konparezon ki pa bon pou yo, epi li retire chak leviye kantitatif yon elèv solid ta ka sèvi pou l parèt.

strings.text: Learning Resources, founded 1985
strings.t: Learning Resources, fonde 1985

strings.text: A real programme with a long history — a K–12 Director plus LR teachers in each division, admission based on a psychoeducational evaluation demonstrating learning differences that impact achievement.
strings.t: Yon vrè pwogram ak yon long istwa — yon Direktè K–12 plis pwofesè LR nan chak divizyon, ak admisyon ki baze sou yon evalyasyon sikoedikatif ki demontre diferans nan aprantisaj ki afekte reyisit.

strings.text: The Upper School model is coaching, not remediation
strings.t: Modèl Upper School la se antrènman, se pa remediyasyon

strings.text: Verbatim: in the Upper School the programme “becomes more of a **consultative and coaching model**”, working on executive functioning — organisation, time management, study strategies. Lower School LR is explicitly remedial; the Upper School is not. Decisive for a family whose 9–12 student needs direct intervention.
strings.t: Mo pou mo: nan Upper School pwogram nan “vin plis yon **modèl konsiltatif ak antrènman**”, k ap travay sou fonksyon egzekitif — òganizasyon, jesyon tan, estrateji etid. LR Lower School eksplisitman remedyal; Upper School la pa ye. Desizif pou yon fanmi ki gen yon elèv 9–12 ki bezwen entèvansyon dirèk.

strings.text: Accommodations and cost
strings.t: Akomodasyon ak depans

strings.text: Middle and Upper School students who qualify have a **504 Educational Plan**, with testing current within three years; typical accommodations include extended time and testing in a separate setting. Critically, **charges for sessions are not included in tuition and are billed per session each month**.
strings.t: Elèv Middle ak Upper School ki kalifye gen yon **504 Educational Plan**, ak tès ki dwe pa gen plis pase twa ane; akomodasyon tipik enkli tan pwolonje ak tès nan yon anviwònman apa. Sa ki enpòtan, **frè pou sesyon yo pa enkli nan frè eskolè a epi yo faktire yo pa sesyon chak mwa**.

strings.text: Do not confuse ATSS with Learning Resources
strings.t: Pa konfonn ATSS ak Learning Resources

strings.text: The Office of Academic Transition and Student Success is a **transition and belonging office** for students new to independent schools, particularly from underrepresented backgrounds. Its page never mentions learning differences, 504 plans or accommodations. A student with dyslexia who is neither new to Latin nor from an underrepresented background falls outside its stated population entirely.
strings.t: Office of Academic Transition and Student Success la se yon **biwo tranzisyon ak apatenans** pou elèv ki nouvo nan lekòl endepandan, sitou sa yo ki soti nan gwoup ki pa byen reprezante. Paj li a pa janm mansyone diferans nan aprantisaj, plan 504 oswa akomodasyon. Yon elèv ki gen disleksi ki ni nouvo nan Latin ni ki soti nan yon gwoup ki pa byen reprezante tonbe nèt deyò popilasyon li deklare a.

strings.text: The published-invisibility problem, verified directly: every descriptive Learning Resources page on the live site now 404s, and the “Learning Resources” tile on the Student Support and Wellness page is an href="#" anchor with no body copy. The 1985 founding, the coaching model, the 504 process and the per-session billing survive only in archived captures — so a prospective family researching learning support today finds a tile that links nowhere. Upper School LR staffing levels and the number of students served are unpublished, and whether Margaret Sigmon is still Director could not be confirmed.
strings.t: Pwoblèm envizibilite nan piblikasyon an, verifye dirèkteman: chak paj deskriptif Learning Resources sou sit ki an dirèk la kounye a bay 404, epi mozayik “Learning Resources” sou paj Student Support and Wellness la se yon ankraj href="#" san okenn tèks. The asterisk marks enrollment for the Class of 2025 only — and Duke, Cornell, Georgetown, Notre Dame, Emory, USC, UVA, Michigan, William & Mary, Colby and Boston College all carry no asterisk, meaning no Class of 2025 graduate enrolled at any of them. The most selective actual enrollments were Dartmouth (a football signee), Davidson (a golf signee), NYU (the valedictorian) and UNC–Chapel Hill (five students). The window starts at 2023, matching the floor the other schools here share; the Class of 2026 has not yet been published as a graduating class, so no 2026 acceptance list exists to extend it forward.
strings.t: sa a se yon lis aksepte atravè twa klas ki gradye, se pa yon lis enskripsyon. Zetwal la make enskripsyon pou Klas 2025 la sèlman — epi Duke, Cornell, Georgetown, Notre Dame, Emory, USC, UVA, Michigan, William & Mary, Colby ak Boston College tout pa pote okenn zetwal, sa ki vle di okenn gradye Klas 2025 pa t enskri nan okenn nan yo. Enskripsyon reyèl ki pi selektif yo se te Dartmouth (yon moun ki siyen nan foutbòl), Davidson (yon moun ki siyen nan gòlf), NYU (elèv ki pi bon an) ak UNC–Chapel Hill (senk elèv). Fenèt la kòmanse an 2023, ki menm ak piba lòt lekòl yo isit la pataje; Klas 2026 la poko pibliye kòm yon klas ki gradye, kidonk pa gen okenn lis aksepte 2026 ki egziste pou pwolonje l pi devan.

strings.text: The school claims “99% attend a four-year college”, but its own named Class of 2025 roster shows about five of 94 graduates at a community college, a real-estate school, in childcare or taking a postgraduate year — closer to 95%. Both are the school’s own figures.
strings.t: Lekòl la reklame “99% ale nan yon inivèsite kat ane”, men pwòp lis Klas 2025 li a ki gen non montre apeprè senk nan 94 gradye nan yon inivèsite kominotè, yon lekòl imobilye, nan gadri oswa k ap pran yon ane apre diplòm — pi pre 95%. Tou de se pwòp chif lekòl la.

strings.text: The Academic Conservatory is the real differentiator — a transcript-noted arts credential — and Winterim puts every student somewhere off campus each January.
strings.t: Academic Conservatory a se vrè diferans la — yon kalifikasyon atistik ki note sou relve nòt — epi Winterim mete chak elèv yon kote deyò kanpis la chak janvye.

strings.text: The second lever is a Christian-college network most peer schools do not have: NACCAP membership and a named Christian-college tier that 14% of graduates actually use.
strings.t: Dezyèm leviye a se yon rezo inivèsite kretyen pifò lekòl parèy pa genyen: manbraj NACCAP ak yon nivo inivèsite kretyen ki gen non ke 14% nan gradye yo sèvi vre.

strings.text: **Academic Conservatory** — the school’s strongest published credential, and critically it is **noted on the transcript**, so it reaches the admissions reader rather than living only in a résumé. Described across sources as covering six or eight areas.
strings.t: **Academic Conservatory** — kalifikasyon ki pi solid lekòl la pibliye, epi sa ki enpòtan li **note sou relve nòt la**, kidonk li rive nan men moun k ap li nan admisyon olye ke viv sèlman nan yon rezime. Dekri atravè sous kòm yon bagay ki kouvri sis oswa uit domèn.

strings.text: **Winterim / January Term** — a required credit every year (0.25 per year toward graduation), supplying internships, travel and vocational shadowing. Note the vocational shadowing component is small: only about seven placements are published.
strings.t: **Winterim / January Term** — yon kredi obligatwa chak ane (0.25 pa ane vè gradyasyon), ki bay estaj, vwayaj ak swiv metye. Note konpozan swiv metye a piti: se sèlman anviwon sèt plasman ki pibliye.

strings.text: **Junior Seminar** — a required, graded half-credit course containing a mock admission committee and two mandatory college visits. Structurally stronger than the optional evening programming most schools offer.
strings.t: **Junior Seminar** — yon kou obligatwa ak nòt demi kredi ki gen yon komite admisyon similye ak de vizit inivèsite obligatwa. Estriktirèlman pi solid pase pwogramasyon aswè opsyonèl pifò lekòl ofri.

strings.text: **Athletic recruiting at scale** — 21 signees in the Class of 2025, roughly 22% of a 94-student class, with athletic scholarships at Florida State, Queens, Wake Forest, Kentucky and New Hampshire.
strings.t: **Rekritman atletik nan gwo echèl** — 21 moun ki siyen nan Klas 2025 la, apeprè 22% nan yon klas 94 elèv, ak bous atletik nan Florida State, Queens, Wake Forest, Kentucky ak New Hampshire.

strings.text: **Seal of Biliteracy** — implemented in 2019 and awarded on a proficiency exam across two languages, though the share earning it fell from 11% of the Class of 2021 to 4% of the Class of 2024.
strings.t: **Seal of Biliteracy** — aplike an 2019 epi yo bay li sou yon egzamen konpetans nan de lang, byenke pòsyon ki genyen l lan te tonbe soti 11% nan Klas 2021 rive 4% nan Klas 2024.

strings.text: **A Christian-college network with its own membership** — Charlotte Christian belongs to **NACCAP**, the Christian-college counseling association, alongside NACAC and SACAC. Its brochure gives Christian colleges a named tier, and 14% of graduates enroll at one, with live pipelines to Wheaton, Liberty, Samford, Cedarville, Grove City, Baylor and Abilene Christian.
strings.t: **Yon rezo inivèsite kretyen ak pwòp manbraj pa l** — Charlotte Christian fè pati **NACCAP**, asosyasyon konsèy inivèsite kretyen an, ansanm ak NACAC ak SACAC. Bwochi li a bay inivèsite kretyen yon nivo ki gen non, epi 14% nan gradye yo enskri nan youn, ak rezo aktif nan Wheaton, Liberty, Samford, Cedarville, Grove City, Baylor ak Abilene Christian.

strings.text: **A named HBCU tier** — Hampton, Howard, Morehouse, NC A&T and Spelman are listed as a distinct group, with confirmed Class of 2025 enrollments at NC A&T and Johnson C. Smith.
strings.t: **Yon nivo HBCU ki gen non** — Hampton, Howard, Morehouse, NC A&T ak Spelman liste kòm yon gwoup apa, ak enskripsyon Klas 2025 konfime nan NC A&T ak Johnson C. Smith.

strings.text: **The School Profile as an instrument** — it publishes a full AP dashboard with AP Scholar breakdowns, a five-quintile GPA table, the grading scale, the weighting formula and the weighting change at the Class of 2019, plus CEEB 340667.
strings.t: **School Profile la kòm yon zouti** — li pibliye yon tablo AP konplè ak dekoupaj AP Scholar, yon tab GPA senk senkyèm, echèl nòt la, fòmil pwa a ak chanjman pwa a nan Klas 2019 la, plis CEEB 340667.

strings.text: **Granular scholarship reporting** — roughly ninety individually named awards published for a single class is far more specific than a headline dollar figure, and lets a family see which institutions actually fund this school’s students.
strings.t: **Rapò granilè sou bous** — apeprè katrevendis prim ki nonmen endividyèlman ki pibliye pou yon sèl klas se pi espesifik lwen pase yon chif dola nan tit, epi li kite yon fanmi wè ki enstitisyon ki finanse elèv lekòl sa a vre.

strings.text: The school does not publish a disciplinary-disclosure policy — whether and how suspensions or honor violations reach the secondary school report is absent despite NACAC membership.
strings.t: Lekòl la pa pibliye yon politik divilgasyon disiplinè — si ak kijan sispansyon oswa vyolasyon onè rive nan rapò lekòl segondè a absan malgre manbraj NACAC.

strings.text: The Academic Conservatory is described as covering six areas in the School Profile and eight on the website. Both are the school’s own figures.
strings.t: Academic Conservatory a dekri kòm yon bagay ki kouvri sis domèn nan School Profile la ak uit sou sit la. Tou de se pwòp chif lekòl la.

strings.text: A full five-quintile GPA table, published every year — and a visible three-year grade inflation in it, with every boundary rising while the bottom floor fell.
strings.t: Yon tab GPA senk senkyèm konplè, pibliye chak ane — ak yon enflasyon nòt vizib sou twa ane ladan l, ak chak limit ki monte pandan planche anba a te tonbe.

strings.text: The median student sits in the third quintile at roughly 3.69–4.06 weighted; because Honors adds 0.5 and AP a full point, a 4.277 top-quintile floor implies a heavy advanced load rather than a perfect record.
strings.t: Elèv medyàn nan chita nan twazyèm senkyèm nan nan apeprè 3.69–4.06 ak pwa; paske Honors ajoute 0.5 ak AP yon pwen konplè, yon planche 4.277 nan senkyèm anwo a sijere yon gwo chay avanse olye ke yon dosye pafè.

strings.text: The school publishes the composite middle-50% band and a tester count only. Those endpoints ARE the 25th and 75th percentiles; the mean, the median and any Reading or Maths section split are unpublished, so none is interpolated here.
strings.t: Lekòl la pibliye bann konpozit mitan-50% la ak yon kantite moun ki pase tès sèlman. Bout sa yo SE 25yèm ak 75yèm pousantaj yo; mwayèn nan, medyàn nan ak nenpòt separasyon seksyon Lekti oswa Matematik pa pibliye, kidonk nou pa entèpole okenn isit la.

strings.text: All five quintiles are the school’s own published figures. Comparing them with the Class of 2022 table shows material movement in three years: every quintile boundary rose — the first-quintile floor from 4.133 to 4.277 and the third from 3.56 to 3.686 — while the fifth-quintile floor FELL from 2.179 to 1.941. The distribution rose at the top and stretched at the bottom. No unweighted distribution is published.
strings.t: Tout senk senkyèm yo se pwòp chif lekòl la pibliye. Konpare yo ak tab Klas 2022 la montre yon mouvman enpòtan nan twa ane: chak limit senkyèm te monte — planche premye senkyèm nan soti 4.133 rive 4.277 ak twazyèm nan soti 3.56 rive 3.686 — pandan planche senkyèm senkyèm nan te TONBE soti 2.179 rive 1.941. Distribisyon an te monte nan tèt la epi li te lonje nan pye a. Pa gen okenn distribisyon san pwa ki pibliye.

strings.text: Two Upper School counselors provide study-skills instruction, course-selection guidance, academic progress monitoring, test-anxiety management, and referrals to outside resources. That is a general counseling function rather than a learning-differences programme.
strings.t: De konseye Upper School bay enstriksyon sou konpetans etid, konsèy pou chwazi kou, siveyans pwogrè akademik, jesyon estrès nan tès, ak referans nan resous deyò. Sa se yon fonksyon konsèy jeneral olye ke yon pwogram pou diferans nan aprantisaj.

strings.text: Credentials are a genuine strength
strings.t: Kalifikasyon yo se yon vrè fòs

strings.text: All counselors hold master’s degrees in counseling or a related field, and several hold clinical licences — LCMHC or LCSW.
strings.t: Tout konseye yo genyen metriz nan konsèy oswa yon domèn ki gen rapò, epi plizyè genyen lisans klinik — LCMHC oswa LCSW.

strings.text: The named academic-support structures
strings.t: Estrikti sipò akademik ki gen non yo

strings.text: **WIN (“What I Need”) labs** and advisory lessons are the named Upper School academic-support structure, and the **Media & Writing Center** is free and writing-specific. What WIN Lab delivers academically is not described.
strings.t: **WIN (“What I Need”) labs** ak leson advisory se estrikti sipò akademik Upper School ki gen non an, epi **Media & Writing Center** la gratis epi li espesifik pou ekri. Sa WIN Lab bay sou plan akademik pa dekri.

strings.text: This is the weakest-documented area in the entire research set. No named learning specialist, no named learning-differences programme, no psycho-educational testing, no 504 or accommodation-plan process, no extended-time policy and no College Board accommodations coordination could be found. Given the school gates Honors and AP placement on an A in the prerequisite course AND mandates AP exams, that combination makes this a priority question rather than a footnote.
strings.t: Sa a se domèn ki mwens byen dokimante nan tout seri rechèch la. Nou pa t kapab jwenn okenn espesyalis aprantisaj ki gen non, okenn pwogram pou diferans nan aprantisaj ki gen non, okenn tès sikoedikatif, okenn pwosesis 504 oswa plan akomodasyon, okenn politik tan pwolonje ak okenn kòdinasyon akomodasyon College Board. Lè w konsidere lekòl la mete plasman Honors ak AP dèyè yon A nan kou kondisyon anvan an EPI li egzije egzamen AP, konbinezon sa a fè sa yon kesyon priyorite olye ke yon nòt anba paj.

strings.text: The middle may be the best-served cohort
strings.t: Mitan an ka gwoup ki pi byen sèvi a

strings.text: The list spans Dartmouth and Duke down to Central Piedmont Community College, Universal Technical Institute, Brevard, Montreat, Belmont Abbey, Limestone, Winthrop, Wingate and Methodist. A fourth- or fifth-quintile student at 3.12 or below has real, named destinations, and the checklist instructs students to include “every possible type of college that might be of interest”.
strings.t: Lis la kouvri Dartmouth ak Duke desann rive nan Central Piedmont Community College, Universal Technical Institute, Brevard, Montreat, Belmont Abbey, Limestone, Winthrop, Wingate ak Methodist. Yon elèv nan katriyèm oswa senkyèm senkyèm nan a 3.12 oswa pi ba gen vrè destinasyon ki gen non, epi lis kontwòl la di elèv yo pou yo enkli “chak kalite inivèsite ki ta ka enterese w”.

strings.text: The Christian-college route is real, not decorative
strings.t: Wout inivèsite kretyen an reyèl, se pa dekoratif

strings.text: 14% of recent graduates enroll at a Christian college, with multiple confirmed Class of 2025 enrollments at Wheaton, Liberty, Samford, Charleston Southern, Cedarville, Grove City, Baylor and Abilene Christian.
strings.t: 14% nan gradye resan yo enskri nan yon inivèsite kretyen, ak plizyè enskripsyon Klas 2025 konfime nan Wheaton, Liberty, Samford, Charleston Southern, Cedarville, Grove City, Baylor ak Abilene Christian.

strings.text: Vocational and non-traditional
strings.t: Metye ak sa ki pa tradisyonèl

strings.text: Universal Technical Institute and Central Piedmont Community College both appear as acceptances, and Central Piedmont as an actual enrollment. No federal service academy appears on either published list.
strings.t: Universal Technical Institute ak Central Piedmont Community College tou de parèt kòm aksepte, epi Central Piedmont kòm yon vrè enskripsyon. Pa gen okenn akademi sèvis federal ki parèt sou ni youn ni lòt lis ki pibliye.

strings.text: The 2021–22 profile published no test scores at all, stating it had “insufficient testing results to report middle 50% test score ranges” for the Class of 2022 — so no multi-year test trend exists, and the 2024–25 edition is the only one carrying SAT and ACT bands.
strings.t: Pwofil 2021–22 la pa t pibliye okenn nòt tès ditou, li te deklare li te gen “rezilta tès ki pa ase pou rapòte ranje nòt tès mitan 50%” pou Klas 2022 la — kidonk pa gen okenn tandans tès plizyè ane ki egziste, epi edisyon 2024–25 la se sèl la ki pote bann SAT ak ACT.

strings.text: No gap-year policy or counselling is published, and neither is any unweighted GPA distribution.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn politik oswa konsèy sou ane apre diplòm ki pibliye, epi pa gen okenn distribisyon GPA san pwa non plis.

strings.text: A structurally rigorous, transparent transcript — mandatory AP exams, a full published quintile table, a granular AP dashboard — attached to the thinnest learning-support disclosure in this set.
strings.t: Yon relve nòt estriktirèlman rijid epi transparan — egzamen AP obligatwa, yon tab senkyèm konplè ki pibliye, yon tablo AP granilè — makonnen ak divilgasyon sipò aprantisaj ki pi mens nan gwoup sa a.

strings.text: The academic reporting is unusually honest. The gaps are concentrated in exactly one place, which makes the tour questions easy to aim.
strings.t: Rapò akademik la onèt yon fason ki pa abityèl. Mank yo konsantre nan yon sèl kote, sa ki fè kesyon pou vizit yo fasil pou vize.

strings.text: AP exams are mandatory, so the pass rate means something
strings.t: Egzamen AP obligatwa, kidonk to reyisit la vle di yon bagay

strings.text: “Students in AP classes are required to take the AP exam” — so 89% scoring 3+ in 2024, up from 78% in 2021, rests on a non-self-selected pool rather than only confident testers.
strings.t: “Elèv nan klas AP oblije pran egzamen AP la” — kidonk 89% ki fè 3+ an 2024, monte soti 78% an 2021, chita sou yon gwoup kote elèv yo pa chwazi tèt yo olye ke sèlman moun ki gen konfyans nan tès.

strings.text: The AP dashboard is the fullest in this set
strings.t: Tablo AP la se sa ki pi konplè nan gwoup sa a

strings.text: exams, students, pass counts and a complete AP Scholar breakdown, published two years deep — 59 AP Scholar awards in 2024 and 203 across the Classes of 2023–25.
strings.t: egzamen, elèv, kantite ki pase ak yon dekoupaj AP Scholar konplè, pibliye de ane pwofondè — 59 prim AP Scholar an 2024 ak 203 atravè Klas 2023–25 yo.

strings.text: A real quintile table, published annually
strings.t: Yon vrè tab senkyèm, pibliye chak ane

strings.text: five quintiles through the sixth semester, so colleges can locate a student’s band without a rank — and comparing editions makes three-year grade movement visible rather than hidden.

strings.text: a graded half-credit course carrying a mock admission committee and two mandatory college visits — more structured than the optional evening programming peers offer.

strings.text: The Conservatory reaches the reader

strings.text: A distinctive network the others do not have
strings.t: Yon rezo distenktif lòt yo pa genyen

strings.text: NACCAP membership plus named Christian-college and HBCU tiers, with 14% of graduates actually enrolling at a Christian college and confirmed pipelines to Wheaton, Liberty, Samford and Baylor.
strings.t: manbraj NACCAP plis nivo inivèsite kretyen ak HBCU ki gen non, ak 14% nan gradye yo ki vrèman enskri nan yon inivèsite kretyen ak rezo konfime nan Wheaton, Liberty, Samford ak Baylor.

strings.text: You publish no named learning specialist, no learning-differences programme and no accommodations policy. Who supports a student with a diagnosed learning difference, and who coordinates College Board accommodations?
strings.t: Ou pa pibliye okenn espesyalis aprantisaj ki gen non, okenn pwogram pou diferans nan aprantisaj ak okenn politik akomodasyon. Kiyès ki sipòte yon elèv ki gen yon diferans nan aprantisaj ki dyagnostike, epi kiyès ki kòdone akomodasyon College Board?

strings.text: Honors and AP placement requires an A in the prerequisite course and AP exams are mandatory. How does that combination work for a student with accommodations?
strings.t: Plasman nan Honors ak AP egzije yon A nan kou kondisyon anvan an epi egzamen AP obligatwa. Kijan konbinezon sa a mache pou yon elèv ki gen akomodasyon?

strings.text: What share of AP exams scored 4 or 5? Only the 3+ threshold is published.
strings.t: Ki pòsyon nan egzamen AP yo ki te fè 4 oswa 5? Se sèlman sèy 3+ la ki pibliye.

strings.text: Your marketing says “45+ AP and honors courses” but roughly 23 AP courses can be enumerated. What is the actual count?
strings.t: Maketing ou di “45+ kou AP ak honors” men apeprè 23 kou AP ka konte. Ki vrè kantite a?

strings.text: Your profile reports 14 National Merit finalists on a rolling 15-year window, down from 16 three years earlier. What were the per-class counts for the last five years?
strings.t: Pwofil ou a rapòte 14 finalis National Merit sou yon peryòd kontinyèl 15 ane, ki desann soti 16 twa ane anvan. Ki kantite pa klas pou senk dènye ane yo?

strings.text: The school lists one Commended Scholar for the Class of 2025 while press coverage names a Semifinalist you do not list. Which is right?
strings.t: Lekòl la liste yon Commended Scholar pou Klas 2025 la pandan kouvèti près la nonmen yon Semifinalis ou pa liste. Kiyès nan yo ki kòrèk?

strings.text: You state 99% attend a four-year college, but the named senior roster shows about five of 94 elsewhere. How is that 99% calculated?
strings.t: Ou deklare 99% ale nan yon inivèsite kat ane, men lis elèv dènye ane ki gen non an montre apeprè senk nan 94 lòt kote. Kijan 99% sa a kalkile?

strings.text: What are the Class of 2026 figures — acceptances, scholarships, and test bands? None are published yet.
strings.t: Ki chif Klas 2026 yo — aksepte, bous, ak bann tès? Okenn pa pibliye ankò.

strings.text: 530 AP exams in 2025 at 93% scoring 3+ and 74% at 4 or 5 — and the school publishes those results discipline by discipline, weak spots included.
strings.t: 530 egzamen AP an 2025 ak 93% ki fè 3+ ak 74% nan 4 oswa 5 — epi lekòl la pibliye rezilta sa yo disiplin pa disiplin, pwen fèb yo enkli.

strings.text: Country Day was the first school in North Carolina to offer the IB Diploma, so a student has two legible routes to maximum rigour rather than one, and the profile names the ceiling course in every discipline.

strings.text: The IB Diploma is the structural differentiator — a second route to maximum rigour — and the Senior Externship turns 175+ local employers into a network only this school has.

strings.text: What Country Day does not have is a required capstone or research thesis; its spike-building is programme breadth rather than a single mandated credential.
strings.t: Sa Country Day pa genyen se yon kapston oswa yon tèz rechèch obligatwa; konstriksyon espesyalite li se etandi pwogram olye ke yon sèl kalifikasyon obligatwa.

strings.text: **IB Diploma Programme** — Country Day was the **first school in North Carolina** to offer it. About 20 students a year take the full diploma from junior year, at an 88% five-year pass rate. For a student whose strengths are not AP-shaped, it is a second legible path to maximum rigour, and it carries an Extended Essay by construction.
strings.t: **IB Diploma Programme** — Country Day se te **premye lekòl nan North Carolina** ki te ofri l. Anviwon 20 elèv pa ane pran diplòm konplè a apati twazyèm ane, ak yon to reyisit 88% sou senk ane. Pou yon elèv ki gen fòs ki pa nan fòm AP, se yon dezyèm wout lizib pou rive nan rigè maksimòm, epi li pote yon Extended Essay pa konstriksyon.

strings.text: **Senior Externship** — a January job-shadowing immersion launched in 2017, partnered with **175+ local employers across 20+ industries**. In a recent year **136 seniors** placed with 68 Charlotte-area employers, hosts drawn largely from current and past parents and alumni.
strings.t: **Senior Externship** — yon imèsyon nan swiv travay nan janvye ki te lanse an 2017, ak patenarya ak **175+ patwon lokal atravè 20+ endistri**. Nan yon ane resan **136 elèv dènye ane** te plase ak 68 patwon nan zòn Charlotte, ak moun ki resevwa yo ki soti sitou nan paran aktyèl ak ansyen ak ansyen elèv.

strings.text: **Science Outreach Program** — rising juniors and seniors work with science professors at local institutions on primary research over the summer, then present at the annual Science Symposium.
strings.t: **Science Outreach Program** — elèv k ap antre nan twazyèm ak dènye ane travay ak pwofesè syans nan enstitisyon lokal sou rechèch prensipal pandan ete a, apre sa yo prezante nan Science Symposium anyèl la.

strings.text: **Weddington Farm** — a **330-acre living classroom** with produce, livestock, beekeeping, mushroom farming and a ten-mile trail system, feeding sustainable-agriculture, ecology and entrepreneurship programming. A genuinely uncommon asset for an urban independent school.
strings.t: **Weddington Farm** — yon **sal klas vivan 330 kawo tè** ak pwodwi, bèt, apikilti, kilti djondjon ak yon sistèm santye dis mil, k ap alimante pwogramasyon nan agrikilti dirab, ekoloji ak antreprenarya. Yon byen vrèman ki pa abityèl pou yon lekòl endepandan iben.

strings.text: **Special Olympics Mecklenburg County Spring Games** — the Upper School has taken a two-day break from classes every April **since 1984** to host. A 40-year institutional commitment reads very differently to an admissions office than a service club.
strings.t: **Special Olympics Mecklenburg County Spring Games** — Upper School la pran yon poz de jou nan klas chak avril **depi 1984** pou resevwa yo. Yon angajman enstitisyonèl 40 ane li byen diferan pou yon biwo admisyon pase yon klib sèvis.

strings.text: There is no required internship, capstone or independent research thesis. The Senior Externship is a single day and is never stated to be mandatory, though 136 of ~141 seniors taking part implies it is near-universal in practice.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn estaj, kapston oswa tèz rechèch endepandan obligatwa. Senior Externship la se yon sèl jou epi yo pa janm di li obligatwa, byenke 136 nan ~141 elèv dènye ane k ap patisipe sijere li prèske inivèsèl an pratik.

strings.text: **The School Profile as an instrument** — and the 2025–26 edition is materially stronger than its predecessor. It ties GPA quintiles to median SAT *and* median ACT, names the ceiling course in every discipline, publishes AP-load buckets, states the weighting formula, and discloses AP results by discipline including the weak spots (Fine Arts at 81%/36%). That candour is itself a credibility signal.
strings.t: **School Profile la kòm yon zouti** — epi edisyon 2025–26 la materyèlman pi solid pase sa anvan l lan. Li makonnen senkyèm GPA ak SAT medyàn *ak* ACT medyàn, li nonmen kou plafon an nan chak disiplin, li pibliye gwoup chay AP, li deklare fòmil pwa a, epi li divilge rezilta AP pa disiplin ki enkli pwen fèb yo (Fine Arts nan 81%/36%). Franchiz sa a se yon siy kredibilite li menm.

strings.text: **Integrity signalling** — an annually pledged Honor Code with a student-run Honor Council, plus ACCIS, NACAC and SACAC membership. Faculty credibility markers matter here too: the Upper School includes **AP exam readers**, National Board graders and Klingenstein Fellows, with 82% holding advanced degrees.
strings.t: **Siyal sou entegrite** — yon Kòd Onè yo pran angajman pou li chak ane ak yon Honor Council elèv yo dirije, plis manbraj ACCIS, NACAC ak SACAC. Mak kredibilite pwofesè enpòtan isit la tou: Upper School la enkli **moun k ap korije egzamen AP**, korektè National Board ak Klingenstein Fellows, ak 82% ki genyen diplòm avanse.

strings.text: **A dominant UNC–Chapel Hill pipeline** — 32 Class of 2026 students enrolled there, 23% of the class, alongside 34 cumulative Morehead-Cain recipients. Add a standing Jefferson Scholar link to UVA and a decade of service-academy appointments.
strings.t: **Yon rezo UNC–Chapel Hill ki domine** — 32 elèv Klas 2026 te enskri la, 23% nan klas la, ansanm ak 34 moun ki resevwa Morehead-Cain kimilatif. Ajoute yon lyen Jefferson Scholar pèmanan ak UVA ak yon deseni nominasyon nan akademi sèvis.

strings.text: **A substantial HBCU pipeline** — North Carolina A&T, Howard, Hampton and Clark Atlanta all enrolling for the Class of 2026, with a February One Scholarship and a Ron Brown Scholar among recent awards.
strings.t: **Yon gwo rezo HBCU** — North Carolina A&T, Howard, Hampton ak Clark Atlanta tout ki enskri pou Klas 2026 la, ak yon February One Scholarship ak yon Ron Brown Scholar pami dènye prim yo.

strings.text: The school does not publish its disciplinary-disclosure policy — whether and how Honor Council findings or suspensions reach the secondary school report. Given published NACAC membership, that omission is a sharp tour question.
strings.t: Lekòl la pa pibliye politik divilgasyon disiplinè li — si ak kijan konklizyon Honor Council oswa sispansyon rive nan rapò lekòl segondè a. Lè w konsidere manbraj NACAC ki pibliye a, omisyon sa a se yon kesyon file pou yon vizit.

strings.t: Tout senk senkyèm yo se pwòp chif lekòl la pibliye — pa gen anyen ki entèpole — epi makonnen chak senkyèm ak yon SAT ak ACT medyàn se te yon bagay nouvo nan pwofil 2025–26 la. strings.text: A named JK–12 structure covering tutoring, accommodations, assessments and evaluation referrals, delivered as hourly sessions before, during or after the school day.
strings.t: Yon estrikti JK–12 ki gen non ki kouvri titora, akomodasyon, evalyasyon ak referans pou evalyasyon, ki bay kòm sesyon pa èdtan anvan, pandan oswa apre jounen lekòl la.

strings.text: The Upper School model
strings.t: Modèl Upper School la

strings.text: **Academic coaches** support content areas and executive function, while **learning specialists** work one-on-one so students “recognize and utilize their strengths” and become independent learners and self-advocates.
strings.t: **Antrenè akademik** sipòte domèn kontni ak fonksyon egzekitif, pandan **espesyalis aprantisaj** travay youn a youn pou elèv yo “rekonèt epi sèvi ak fòs yo” epi vin moun k ap aprann endepandan ki ka defann tèt yo.

strings.text: Where it reaches the application
strings.t: Kote li rive nan aplikasyon an

strings.text: Uniquely among the schools here, the ERP explicitly **“assists in requesting accommodations with the College Board, ACT, and IB”** — the hand-off into admissions testing is stated rather than left implicit.
strings.t: Inikman pami lekòl isit yo, ERP la eksplisitman **“ede nan mande akomodasyon nan College Board, ACT, ak IB”** — pasaj la nan tès admisyon an deklare olye ke kite l enplisit.

strings.text: No learning specialist or academic coach is named anywhere, and no staff count or credentials are published — so the caseload behind that model is unknown.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn espesyalis aprantisaj oswa antrenè akademik ki nonmen okenn kote, epi pa gen kantite estaf oswa kalifikasyon ki pibliye — kidonk chay ki dèyè modèl sa a enkoni.

strings.text: The enrolling names are not a top-25 highlight reel — Appalachian State, East Carolina, UNC–Charlotte, High Point, Queens, Liberty, Tampa, Mississippi, Kentucky and Southwest Minnesota State all appear. **55% of the Class of 2026 enrolled at public universities** and 32% stayed in North Carolina.
strings.t: Non ki enskri yo se pa yon lis top-25 — Appalachian State, East Carolina, UNC–Charlotte, High Point, Queens, Liberty, Tampa, Mississippi, Kentucky ak Southwest Minnesota State tout parèt. **55% nan Klas 2026 la te enskri nan inivèsite piblik** epi 32% te rete nan North Carolina.

strings.text: Community colleges published
strings.t: Inivèsite kominotè ki pibliye

strings.text: Cape Fear and Central Piedmont both appear on the acceptance list. Many peer schools quietly omit their community-college acceptances; publishing them is a meaningful transparency signal.
strings.t: Cape Fear ak Central Piedmont tou de parèt sou lis aksepte a. Anpil lekòl parèy kite aksepte nan inivèsite kominotè yo deyò an silans; pibliye yo se yon siy transparans enpòtan.

strings.text: About fourteen dedicated arts and music institutions (Berklee enrolling, plus Manhattan School of Music, RISD, Pratt, SAIC, Parsons in New York and Paris, UNCSA); all three federal service academies with a Naval Academy appointment; and around eleven international universities including Toronto, St Andrews, Edinburgh and Durham.
strings.t: Anviwon katòz enstitisyon atistik ak mizik dedye (Berklee ki enskri, plis Manhattan School of Music, RISD, Pratt, SAIC, Parsons nan New York ak Pari, UNCSA); tout twa akademi sèvis federal yo ak yon nominasyon nan Naval Academy; ak anviwon onz inivèsite entènasyonal ki enkli Toronto, St Andrews, Edinburgh ak Durham.

strings.text: The 2025–26 profile DROPPED the SAT and ACT middle-50% ranges that the 2024–25 edition published, replacing them with per-quintile medians. The number of testers has never been published in any year — a table showing medians without a sample size shows a shape without an N.
strings.t: Pwofil 2025–26 la te RETIRE ranje mitan-50% SAT ak ACT edisyon 2024–25 la te pibliye yo, epi li te ranplase yo ak medyàn pa senkyèm. Kantite moun ki pase tès pa janm pibliye nan okenn ane — yon tab ki montre medyàn san yon gwosè echantiyon montre yon fòm san yon N.

strings.text: The two profiles give the Class of 2025 different senior counts (138 versus 141) and report different statistics for the same class — means and ranges in one edition, medians in the other — so the top-quintile 4.540 mean and 4.472 median are both correct and not comparable.
strings.t: De pwofil yo bay Klas 2025 la kantite elèv dènye ane diferan (138 kont 141) epi yo rapòte estatistik diferan pou menm klas la — mwayèn ak ranje nan yon edisyon, medyàn nan lòt la — kidonk mwayèn 4.540 ak medyàn 4.472 senkyèm anwo yo tou de kòrèk epi yo pa konparab.

strings.text: No gap-year counselling, placement count or deferral policy is published, and neither is any direct-to-work or enlistment outcome.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn konsèy, kantite plasman oswa politik sou ane apre diplòm ki pibliye, epi pa gen okenn rezilta sou ale dirèk nan travay oswa nan lame non plis.

strings.text: A deep, stable office and an unusually candid profile — Country Day hands admissions readers more usable context than almost any peer, then declines to publish its own test scores.
strings.t: Yon biwo pwofon ak estab ak yon pwofil ki fran yon fason ki pa abityèl — Country Day bay moun k ap li nan admisyon plis kontèks itil pase prèske nenpòt lekòl parèy, apre sa li refize pibliye pwòp nòt tès li.

strings.text: The strengths are structural and durable; the gaps are disclosure choices, which is exactly what a tour can put pressure on.
strings.t: Fòs yo estriktirèl epi dirab; mank yo se chwa nan divilgasyon, sa ki se egzakteman sa yon vizit ka peze sou li.

strings.text: The profile gives readers more context than peers
strings.t: Pwofil la bay moun k ap li plis kontèks pase lekòl parèy

strings.text: a quintile table tying GPA bands to median SAT *and* median ACT, from 4.472/1470/33 down to 2.991/1110/24. No rank is ever assigned, yet a reader can place any candidate precisely — and the per-quintile test medians were a new investment in 2025–26.
strings.t: yon tab senkyèm ki makonnen bann GPA ak SAT medyàn *ak* ACT medyàn, soti 4.472/1470/33 desann rive 2.991/1110/24. Yo pa janm bay okenn ran, poutan yon moun k ap li ka plase nenpòt kandida avèk presizyon — epi medyàn tès pa senkyèm yo se te yon nouvo envestisman an 2025–26.

strings.text: AP performance is high, improving and candidly disclosed
strings.t: Pèfòmans AP wo, k ap amelyore epi divilge fransman

strings.text: 530 exams at 93% scoring 3+ and 74% at 4–5, up from 89%/70% a year earlier — published discipline by discipline, including Fine Arts at 81%/36% rather than hiding it.
strings.t: 530 egzamen ak 93% ki fè 3+ ak 74% nan 4–5, monte soti 89%/70% yon ane anvan — pibliye disiplin pa disiplin, ki enkli Fine Arts nan 81%/36% olye ke kache l.

strings.text: The IB Diploma is a real structural differentiator
strings.t: Diplòm IB la se yon vrè diferans estriktirèl

strings.text: first in North Carolina to offer it, ~20 full-diploma candidates a year from junior year, 88% five-year pass rate — a second legible path to maximum rigour for students who are not AP-shaped.
strings.t: premye nan North Carolina ki te ofri l, ~20 kandida diplòm konplè pa ane apati twazyèm ane, to reyisit 88% sou senk ane — yon dezyèm wout lizib pou rive nan rigè maksimòm pou elèv ki pa nan fòm AP.

strings.text: The office is deep and stable through a director change
strings.t: Biwo a pwofon epi estab malgre yon chanjman direktè

strings.text: five counselors, 100+ years of combined experience, 150+ reps a year through a structured Scoir Visits programme — and two counselors with a decade-plus in the office, so the July 2026 leadership change sits on institutional memory rather than a vacuum.
strings.t: senk konseye, 100+ ane eksperyans konbine, 150+ reprezantan pa ane atravè yon pwogram Scoir Visits estriktire — epi de konseye ak plis pase yon deseni nan biwo a, kidonk chanjman lidèchip jiyè 2026 la chita sou memwa enstitisyonèl olye ke yon vid.

strings.text: The timeline starts genuinely early
strings.t: Kalandriye a kòmanse vrèman bonè

strings.text: Freshman Seminar and Scoir in 9th grade, PreACT and the Charlotte Area Case Studies mock committee in 10th, one-on-one meetings from junior second semester, and an essay workshop in August before senior year.
strings.t: Freshman Seminar ak Scoir nan 9yèm ane, PreACT ak komite similye Charlotte Area Case Studies nan 10yèm, reyinyon youn a youn apati dezyèm semès twazyèm ane, ak yon atelye redaksyon nan out anvan dènye ane a.

strings.text: The outcomes are honest across the whole distribution
strings.t: Rezilta yo onèt atravè tout distribisyon an

strings.text: 70 destinations for 141 seniors, 55% public and 45% private, community colleges published alongside Princeton and MIT, 32 students to UNC–Chapel Hill, and a substantial HBCU pipeline with four institutions enrolling.
strings.t: 70 destinasyon pou 141 elèv dènye ane, 55% piblik ak 45% prive, inivèsite kominotè pibliye ansanm ak Princeton ak MIT, 32 elèv nan UNC–Chapel Hill, ak yon gwo rezo HBCU ak kat enstitisyon ki enskri.

strings.text: Your 2024–25 profile published SAT and ACT middle-50% ranges and the 2025–26 edition dropped them. Why — and what were the Class of 2025 and 2026 ranges, and how many students tested?
strings.t: Pwofil 2024–25 ou a te pibliye ranje mitan-50% SAT ak ACT epi edisyon 2025–26 la te retire yo. Poukisa — epi ki ranje Klas 2025 ak 2026 yo, epi konbyen elèv ki te pase tès?

strings.text: The Class of 2025 had 2 National Merit Semifinalists where the classes either side had 7 and 6. What happened that year?
strings.t: Klas 2025 la te gen 2 Semifinalis National Merit kote klas ki toutbò l yo te gen 7 ak 6. Kisa ki te pase ane sa a?

strings.text: No Class of 2026 student enrolled at an Ivy, and Harvard is absent across seven published classes. How do you read that, and what does Ivy matriculation look like year over year?
strings.t: Okenn elèv Klas 2026 pa t enskri nan yon Ivy, epi Harvard absan atravè sèt klas ki pibliye. Kijan ou li sa, epi kijan enskripsyon nan Ivy ye ane apre ane?

strings.text: What exactly does the “34 Morehead-Cain recipients” figure cover — how many years? The Class of 2026 post names exactly one.
strings.t: Kisa egzakteman chif “34 moun ki resevwa Morehead-Cain” la kouvri — konbyen ane? Piblikasyon Klas 2026 la nonmen egzakteman youn.

strings.text: How many learning specialists and academic coaches work with Upper School students, what are their credentials, and what is the caseload?
strings.t: Konbyen espesyalis aprantisaj ak antrenè akademik k ap travay ak elèv Upper School, ki kalifikasyon yo, epi ki chay la?

strings.text: How do you report Honor Council findings and disciplinary actions on the secondary school report?
strings.t: Kijan ou rapòte konklizyon Honor Council ak aksyon disiplinè sou rapò lekòl segondè a?

strings.text: How many colleges do your counselors visit each year, is the Senior Externship required, and what gap-year, post-AP computer science, or capstone-research options exist?
strings.t: Konbyen inivèsite konseye ou yo vizite chak ane, èske Senior Externship la obligatwa, epi ki opsyon ki egziste pou ane apre diplòm, syans enfòmatik pòs-AP, oswa rechèch kapston?

strings.text: Cannon publishes something almost no peer does — an explicit maximum AP/AT load by grade, capping a four-year transcript at eleven advanced courses and barring freshmen entirely.
strings.t: Cannon pibliye yon bagay prèske okenn lekòl parèy pa fè — yon chay maksimòm AP/AT eksplisit pa nivo, ki limite yon relve nòt kat ane a onz kou avanse epi ki entèdi elèv premye ane nèt.

strings.text: That ceiling is the key to reading a Cannon transcript: “most rigorous” here has a hard, published limit, and the 92% scoring 3+ comes from students who chose to sit an optional exam.
strings.t: Plafon sa a se kle pou li yon relve nòt Cannon: “pi rijid la” isit la gen yon limit di ki pibliye, epi 92% ki fè 3+ la soti nan elèv ki te chwazi pase yon egzamen opsyonèl.

strings.text: advanced courses — 13 AP plus 8 school-designed Advanced Topics
strings.t: kou avanse — 13 AP plis 8 Advanced Topics lekòl la konsevwa

strings.text: of AP exams scored 3+ (425 exams, 197 students, Class of 2025)
strings.t: nan egzamen AP yo te fè 3+ (425 egzamen, 197 elèv, Klas 2025)

strings.text: published max AP/AT courses in grades 9 / 10 / 11 / 12
strings.t: maksimòm kou AP/AT ki pibliye nan nivo 9 / 10 / 11 / 12

strings.text: “Cannon School does not rank students”
strings.t: “Cannon School pa bay elèv ran”

strings.text: The ceiling is **AP Calculus BC / AP Statistics** — there is no published post-BC course, no multivariable calculus and no linear algebra. An “AT: Calculus with Applications” listed in 2024–25 has disappeared from the 2025–26 table.
strings.t: Plafon an se **AP Calculus BC / AP Statistics** — pa gen okenn kou pòs-BC ki pibliye, pa gen kalkil miltivaryab ak pa gen aljèb lineyè. Yon “AT: Calculus with Applications” ki te liste an 2024–25 disparèt nan tab 2025–26 la.

strings.text: **AP Computer Science only**, with no post-AP course and no data structures — thin relative to the rest of the advanced catalogue.
strings.t: **AP Computer Science sèlman**, san okenn kou pòs-AP ak san estrikti done — mens parapò ak rès katalòg avanse a.

strings.text: Advanced Topics
strings.t: Advanced Topics

strings.text: Eight **school-designed AT courses** sit alongside the APs and carry the same 1.0 quality point, several with no corresponding College Board exam at all — for example AT: Design Thinking for Entrepreneurship.
strings.t: Uit **kou AT lekòl la konsevwa** chita akote AP yo epi yo pote menm 1.0 pwen kalite a, plizyè san okenn egzamen College Board korespondan ditou — pa egzanp AT: Design Thinking for Entrepreneurship.

strings.text: No Global Online Academy membership and no dual-enrolment partnership is published — this was checked specifically.
strings.t: Pa gen manbraj Global Online Academy ak pa gen patenarya enskripsyon doub ki pibliye — nou tcheke sa espesyalman.

strings.text: Weighted narrowly, and deliberately
strings.t: Ak pwa etwat, epi espre

strings.text: AT and AP courses carry **1.0 quality point; Honors and Honors Accelerated are not weighted at all**. Both weighted and unweighted GPAs are calculated from Cannon coursework only.
strings.t: Kou AT ak AP pote **1.0 pwen kalite; Honors ak Honors Accelerated pa gen pwa ditou**. Yo kalkile GPA ak pwa ak san pwa apati kou Cannon sèlman.

strings.text: No rank, and a modest ceiling
strings.t: Pa gen ran, ak yon plafon modès

strings.text: No rank, no decile or quintile table — but the narrow weighting plus the eleven-course cap means the weighted top decile tops out around **4.28**. Cannon does not produce inflated 4.9 GPAs, which needs context for readers used to heavier schemes.
strings.t: Pa gen ran, pa gen tab dizyèm oswa senkyèm — men pwa etwat la plis limit onz kou a vle di dizyèm anwo ak pwa a rive nan tèt otou **4.28**. Cannon pa pwodui GPA anfle 4.9, sa ki bezwen kontèks pou moun ki abitye ak sistèm pi lou.

strings.text: A per-discipline rigour key
strings.t: Yon kle rigè pa disiplin

strings.text: Bold entries in the profile’s course table mark the “most demanding coursework in that discipline per appropriate grade level”, so a reader can see the ceiling subject by subject rather than guessing.
strings.t: Antre an gra nan tab kou pwofil la make “kou ki pi egzijan nan disiplin sa a pou nivo ki apwopriye a”, kidonk yon moun k ap li ka wè plafon an matyè pa matyè olye ke devine.

strings.text: AP exams are OPTIONAL — “students in AT/AP classes have the option of sitting for the appropriate AP exam”. The 92.39% scoring 3+ therefore rests on a self-selected pool and is not directly comparable with schools that mandate the exam. The 197-student denominator is also undefined: it most likely means all Upper School exam takers rather than members of the 111-person graduating class.
strings.t: Egzamen AP yo OPSYONÈL — “elèv nan klas AT/AP gen opsyon pou pase egzamen AP ki apwopriye a”. 92.39% ki fè 3+ la kidonk chita sou yon gwoup ki chwazi tèt li epi li pa dirèkteman konparab ak lekòl ki egzije egzamen an. Baz kalkil 197 elèv la pa defini tou: gen anpil chans li vle di tout elèv Upper School ki pase egzamen olye ke manm klas 111 moun ki gradye a.

strings.text: No National Merit ledger of any kind is published — no Semifinalist, Finalist or Commended counts in any year, on either profile or in news posts. Repeated searches surfaced only a 2011 item naming a single Scholar. AP Scholar counts and the share scoring 4–5 are likewise unpublished; Cannon reports only the 3+ threshold.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn lis National Merit ditou ki pibliye — pa gen kantite Semifinalis, Finalis oswa Commended nan okenn ane, ni sou pwofil la ni nan piblikasyon nouvèl. Rechèch repete te bay sèlman yon atik 2011 ki nonmen yon sèl Scholar. Kantite AP Scholar ak pòsyon ki fè 4–5 la pa pibliye menm jan an; Cannon rapòte sèlman sèy 3+ la.

strings.text: The full grading scale appeared in the 2024–25 profile and was dropped from the 2025–26 edition — a disclosure regression, since a reader of the current profile cannot map a letter grade to a quality point.
strings.t: Echèl nòt konplè a te parèt nan pwofil 2024–25 la epi yo te retire l nan edisyon 2025–26 la — yon rekil nan divilgasyon, paske yon moun k ap li pwofil aktyèl la pa ka makonnen yon nòt lèt ak yon pwen kalite.

strings.text: Cannon promises something structural that most schools do not: a student keeps the same college counselor for all four years, rather than being handed off in junior year.
strings.t: Cannon pwomèt yon bagay estriktirèl pifò lekòl pa fè: yon elèv kenbe menm konseye inivèsite a pandan tout kat ane yo, olye ke yo pase l bay yon lòt nan twazyèm ane.

strings.text: Five staff, zero turnover across two published profiles, and a co-director model — plus the regional case-studies programme it physically hosts.
strings.t: Senk estaf, zewo woulman atravè de pwofil ki pibliye, ak yon modèl ko-direktè — plis pwogram etid ka rejyonal la li resevwa fizikman.

strings.text: This is Cannon’s single largest outcome-data gap. No merit-scholarship dollar figure appears on either profile or in any news post, and no current Morehead-Cain, Park, QuestBridge or ROTC outcome is published. Cannon does publish $3,000,000 in tuition assistance to 24% of its students — but that is the school’s own inbound financial aid, not college merit money, and the two must not be conflated.
strings.t: Sa a se pi gwo mank nan done rezilta Cannon. Pa gen okenn chif dola bous merit ki parèt ni sou pwofil la ni nan okenn piblikasyon nouvèl, epi pa gen okenn rezilta Morehead-Cain, Park, QuestBridge oswa ROTC aktyèl ki pibliye. Cannon pibliye vre $3,000,000 nan asistans frè eskolè bay 24% nan elèv li yo — men sa se pwòp èd finansye lekòl la resevwa, se pa lajan merit inivèsitè, epi ou pa dwe konfonn de yo.

strings.text: the headline list is explicitly “College Acceptances” across three graduating classes (2022, 2023, 2024) — roughly 330 students, each generating multiple acceptances. An institution appearing there does not mean a Cannon student attended, or that an acceptance happened in any particular year. Prefer the Class of 2023 matriculation list, which is real enrollment. Note also that the 2025–26 profile dropped the acceptance list entirely, so the newest available data is already one full cycle stale. This window begins in 2022, a year earlier than the 2023 floor the other schools here share: Cannon publishes only this single pre-aggregated block with no per-class breakdown, so the 2022 acceptances cannot be split off without discarding the list, and the school has published nothing newer to replace it.
strings.t: lis prensipal la se eksplisitman “College Acceptances” atravè twa klas ki gradye (2022, 2023, 2024) — apeprè 330 elèv, chak k ap jenere plizyè aksepte. Yon enstitisyon ki parèt la pa vle di yon elèv Cannon te ale, oswa ke yon aksepte te fèt nan yon ane patikilye. Prefere lis enskripsyon Klas 2023 la, ki se vrè enskripsyon. Note tou ke pwofil 2025–26 la retire lis aksepte a nèt, kidonk done ki pi nouvo ki disponib la deja yon sik konplè ansyen. Fenèt sa a kòmanse an 2022, yon ane anvan piba 2023 lòt lekòl yo isit la pataje: Cannon pibliye sèlman yon sèl blòk pre-agrege sa a, san okenn dekonpozisyon pa klas, kidonk aksepte 2022 yo pa ka separe san jete lis la, epi lekòl la pa pibliye anyen ki pi nouvo pou ranplase l.

strings.text: The profile’s bold “enrolled” markers for the Class of 2024 did not survive PDF text extraction, so the enrolling markers here come from the separately published Class of 2023 matriculation list instead. They are real enrollments, but for a different class than the acceptance list’s bold key describes.
strings.t: Mak “enskri” an gra pwofil la pou Klas 2024 la pa t siviv ekstraksyon tèks PDF, kidonk mak enskripsyon isit yo soti nan lis enskripsyon Klas 2023 ki pibliye apa a. Yo se vrè enskripsyon, men pou yon klas diferan pase sa kle gra lis aksepte a dekri.

strings.text: Cannon’s differentiator is a set of course-embedded research experiences that end in a public defence — including one judged by an external committee of science professionals and business leaders.
strings.t: Sa ki fè Cannon diferan se yon seri eksperyans rechèch ki entegre nan kou yo ki fini nan yon defans piblik — ki enkli youn yon komite ekstèn pwofesyonèl syantifik ak lidè biznis jije.

strings.text: The spike here is built inside the curriculum rather than bolted on: take the course, and the defensible artefact is a requirement rather than an option.
strings.t: Espesyalite a bati anndan kourikoulòm nan olye ke kole sou li: pran kou a, epi rezilta ou ka defann nan se yon kondisyon olye ke yon opsyon.

strings.text: **BIOREX** — the Biological Research Experience, embedded in Honors Biology. Students form a hypothesis, test it, analyse it statistically and present to a committee of **faculty, science professionals and local business leaders**. External judging is what separates this from a class project.
strings.t: **BIOREX** — Biological Research Experience la, entegre nan Honors Biology. Elèv yo fòme yon ipotèz, teste l, analize l estatistikman epi prezante l bay yon komite **pwofesè, pwofesyonèl syantifik ak lidè biznis lokal**. Jijman ekstèn se sa ki separe sa a de yon pwojè klas.

strings.text: **Symposium and Portfolio Defense** — an original historical argument defended in the spring of junior year (AT: U.S. History), and a multi-draft digital portfolio presented in AT: American Language and Composition.
strings.t: **Symposium ak Portfolio Defense** — yon agiman istorik orijinal ou defann nan prentan twazyèm ane a (AT: U.S. History), ak yon pòtfèy dijital ak plizyè bouyon ou prezante nan AT: American Language and Composition.

strings.text: **Independent Study** — petition-based, and unusually the student **co-develops the course content and the assessment rubric**, then produces an end-of-year artefact.
strings.t: **Independent Study** — baze sou demann, epi yon fason ki pa abityèl elèv la **ko-devlope kontni kou a ak rubrik evalyasyon an**, apre sa li pwodui yon rezilta nan fen ane a.

strings.text: **Senior Capstone** — a philanthropic service project with a culminating public presentation to faculty, staff, peers and community. It is the one near-universal senior experience, though service itself is explicitly not a graduation requirement.
strings.t: **Senior Capstone** — yon pwojè sèvis filantwopik ak yon prezantasyon piblik final bay pwofesè, anplwaye, kanmarad ak kominote a. Se sèl eksperyans dènye ane ki prèske inivèsèl, byenke sèvis li menm eksplisitman se pa yon kondisyon pou gradye.

strings.text: **Global Education Certificate** — fully specified: World History I–II plus three levels of a world language, a senior **Glocal Perspectives** course with a capstone essay and presentation, and at least two of three global experiences. Awarded at Senior Night.
strings.t: **Global Education Certificate** — konplètman espesifye: World History I–II plis twa nivo yon lang etranje, yon kou **Glocal Perspectives** nan dènye ane ak yon redaksyon kapston ak prezantasyon, ak omwen de nan twa eksperyans mondyal. Yo bay li nan Senior Night.

strings.text: Entrepreneurship and Engineering exist as course tracks with real depth — Honors Design Thinking & Entrepreneurship Lab, Creative Design and Engineering I–III, The Mill makerspace — but there is no published distinction or credential for either, so they should be read as tracks rather than certificates. No required internship or externship programme is published.
strings.t: Antreprenarya ak Enjenyri egziste kòm pis kou ak vrè pwofondè — Honors Design Thinking & Entrepreneurship Lab, Creative Design and Engineering I–III, makerspace The Mill — men pa gen okenn distenksyon oswa kalifikasyon ki pibliye pou ni youn ni lòt, kidonk yo ta dwe li kòm pis olye ke sètifika. Pa gen okenn pwogram estaj oswa externship obligatwa ki pibliye.

strings.text: **The profile publishes its own ceiling** — the maximum AP/AT load by grade, with a footnote that maths placement governs whether a student can reach it. Disclosing the cap protects students from being read against an unlimited-load norm they were never allowed to attempt.
strings.t: **Pwofil la pibliye pwòp plafon pa l** — chay maksimòm AP/AT pa nivo, ak yon nòt ki di plasman matematik gouvène si yon elèv ka rive nan li. Divilge limit la pwoteje elèv kont yo li yo kont yon nòm chay san limit yo pa t janm gen dwa eseye.

strings.text: **Integrity signalling** — the office “reports out-of-school suspensions and expulsions through time of graduation to any colleges and universities that request this information”: a disclose-on-request posture consistent with current NACAC norms.
strings.t: **Siyal sou entegrite** — biwo a “rapòte sispansyon deyò lekòl ak ekspilsyon jiska moman gradyasyon bay nenpòt inivèsite ak kolèj ki mande enfòmasyon sa a”: yon pozisyon divilge-sou-demann ki konsistan ak nòm NACAC aktyèl yo.

strings.text: **Institutional memberships** — NACAC, SACAC and **ACCIS**, alongside a **Cum Laude Society** chapter awarded in 2005 and membership of the **Independent Curriculum Group**, which is what makes the school-designed AT tier and the optional-exam stance coherent rather than idiosyncratic.
strings.t: **Manbraj enstitisyonèl** — NACAC, SACAC ak **ACCIS**, ansanm ak yon chapit **Cum Laude Society** yo te akòde an 2005 ak manbraj **Independent Curriculum Group** la, ki se sa ki fè nivo AT lekòl la konsevwa a ak pozisyon egzamen opsyonèl la koyeran olye ke etranj.

strings.text: **Hosting regional admissions traffic** — Cannon is the venue for the Lake Norman case-studies programme and fair, pulling visiting admissions officers onto its own campus at regional scale rather than only sending students out.
strings.t: **Resevwa trafik admisyon rejyonal** — Cannon se kote Lake Norman case-studies pwogram nan ak fwa a fèt, sa ki rale ofisye admisyon k ap vizite sou pwòp kanpis li nan yon echèl rejyonal olye ke sèlman voye elèv deyò.

strings.text: Cannon publishes a top-10% band and a middle-50% band for both tests and both GPAs — a genuinely useful shape, reported in a format that is not percentiles.
strings.t: Cannon pibliye yon bann top-10% ak yon bann mitan-50% pou tou de tès ak tou de GPA — yon fòm ki vrèman itil, rapòte nan yon fòma ki pa pousantaj.

strings.text: The most informative figure is the unweighted middle 50% of 3.57–3.94: the median Cannon student sits in the high-B-plus to A-minus range before any weighting.
strings.t: Chif ki pi enfòmatif la se mitan 50% san pwa a ki se 3.57–3.94: elèv medyàn Cannon chita nan ranje B-plis wo rive A-mwens anvan okenn pwa.

strings.text: Cannon publishes a middle-50% band and a top-10% band only. The middle-50% endpoints conventionally ARE the 25th and 75th percentiles, so those columns are real; the top-10% figure is shown in the 90th column as the floor of that band (1470–1590). No mean, median, section subscores, or tester counts are published for either test.
strings.t: Cannon pibliye yon bann mitan-50% ak yon bann top-10% sèlman. Bout mitan-50% yo konvansyonèlman SE 25yèm ak 75yèm pousantaj yo, kidonk kolòn sa yo reyèl; chif top-10% la montre nan kolòn 90yèm nan kòm planche bann sa a (1470–1590). Pa gen mwayèn, medyàn, sou-nòt seksyon, oswa kantite moun ki pase tès ki pibliye pou ni youn ni lòt tès.

strings.text: Same reporting format: the 90th column shows the floor of the published top-10% band (33–36). Without a tester count there is no way to tell what share of 111 seniors sat either exam, which materially limits how far these bands can be read.
strings.t: Menm fòma rapò: kolòn 90yèm nan montre planche bann top-10% ki pibliye a (33–36). San yon kantite moun ki pase tès pa gen okenn fason pou di ki pòsyon nan 111 elèv dènye ane yo ki te pase nenpòt nan de egzamen yo, sa ki limite materyèlman jiskaki kote ou ka li bann sa yo.

strings.text: **Michelle Donah**, **Tere Hurtado** and **Jennifer Ridenhour** — substantial staffing for 423 Upper School students, and among the best-documented learning support in this set.
strings.t: **Michelle Donah**, **Tere Hurtado** ak **Jennifer Ridenhour** — gwo estaf pou 423 elèv Upper School, epi pami sipò aprantisaj ki pi byen dokimante nan gwoup sa a.

strings.text: The student owns the plan

strings.text: Students **actively participate in creating their own personalized learning plans** with specific accommodations, supported by a formally constituted team: the student, parents, teachers, the Assistant Head for Academics, the Student Dean, the Upper School Counselor and the advisor.
strings.t: Elèv yo **patisipe aktivman nan kreye pwòp plan aprantisaj pèsonalize pa yo** ak akomodasyon espesifik, sipòte pa yon ekip ki fòme fòmèlman: elèv la, paran yo, pwofesè yo, Assistant Head for Academics la, Student Dean an, Upper School Counselor la ak konseye a.

strings.text: For **juniors and seniors** the programme provides guidance on **requesting College Board and ACT testing accommodations** — the specific service that converts learning support into college-application support.
strings.t: Pou **elèv twazyèm ak dènye ane** pwogram nan bay konsèy sou **mande akomodasyon tès College Board ak ACT** — sèvis espesifik la ki konvèti sipò aprantisaj an sipò pou aplikasyon inivèsitè.

strings.text: The **Academic Resource Center** for maths, writing, science and world languages; 1:1 **academic coaching** on executive function; and a faculty-facilitated, peer-led **Academic Lab**.
strings.t: **Academic Resource Center** la pou matematik, ekri, syans ak lang etranje; **antrènman akademik** 1:1 sou fonksyon egzekitif; ak yon **Academic Lab** kanmarad yo dirije ak pwofesè k ap fasilite.

strings.text: Not published: how many students are on formal learning plans, whether accommodations carry a fee, and specialist credentials.
strings.t: Pa pibliye: konbyen elèv ki gen plan aprantisaj fòmèl, si akomodasyon yo gen yon frè, ak kalifikasyon espesyalis yo.

strings.text: The acceptance list runs from MIT, Stanford and Bowdoin down through Rowan-Cabarrus, Cape Fear and Central Piedmont community colleges, Brevard, Barton, Catawba, Mars Hill, Wingate, Limestone, Methodist, Gardner-Webb, Guilford, Lenoir-Rhyne and Coker. A school optimising for prestige would omit these; Cannon prints them, and discloses its 2% two-year figure rather than burying it.
strings.t: Lis aksepte a kouri soti MIT, Stanford ak Bowdoin desann atravè inivèsite kominotè Rowan-Cabarrus, Cape Fear ak Central Piedmont, Brevard, Barton, Catawba, Mars Hill, Wingate, Limestone, Methodist, Gardner-Webb, Guilford, Lenoir-Rhyne ak Coker. Yon lekòl k ap optimize pou prestij ta kite sa yo deyò; Cannon enprime yo, epi li divilge chif 2% de ane li a olye ke antere l.

strings.text: Pratt, Parsons, SAIC, SCAD, Ringling, FIT, FIDM, UNCSA and Emerson — deep and visual/design-weighted rather than music-conservatory-weighted, despite strong ensemble offerings.
strings.t: Pratt, Parsons, SAIC, SCAD, Ringling, FIT, FIDM, UNCSA ak Emerson — pwofon epi ki panche vè vizyèl/konsepsyon olye ke vè konsèvatwa mizik, malgre bon ofrann ansanm.

strings.text: International universities (St Andrews, Edinburgh, Aberdeen — a confirmed 2023 enrollment, University College Dublin, McGill, Toronto); service academies and the military (Air Force Academy, The Citadel, VMI); technical institutes (Rose-Hulman, WPI, Stevens, Colorado School of Mines, RPI); HBCUs (Howard, Spelman, NC A&T, NC Central, Winston-Salem State).
strings.t: Inivèsite entènasyonal (St Andrews, Edinburgh, Aberdeen — yon enskripsyon 2023 konfime, University College Dublin, McGill, Toronto); akademi sèvis ak lame a (Air Force Academy, The Citadel, VMI); enstiti teknik (Rose-Hulman, WPI, Stevens, Colorado School of Mines, RPI); HBCU (Howard, Spelman, NC A&T, NC Central, Winston-Salem State).

strings.text: The 2024–25 profile published NO test scores at all, stating that because of test-optional review “test scores for the Class of 2025 are not reported”. The 2025–26 profile then published a full Class of 2025 testing distribution. Same class, opposite decisions, one year apart, unexplained — the later figures are shown here.
strings.t: Pwofil 2024–25 la pa t pibliye OKENN nòt tès ditou, li te deklare akoz revizyon ak tès opsyonèl “nou pa rapòte nòt tès pou Klas 2025 la”. Apre sa pwofil 2025–26 la te pibliye yon distribisyon tès Klas 2025 konplè. Menm klas la, desizyon opoze, yon ane apa, san eksplikasyon — nou montre chif ki pi resan yo isit la.

strings.text: All four GPA bands are identical to the hundredth across the Class of 2024 and Class of 2025 tables. An exact four-band match across two different cohorts is statistically unlikely, so this may be carried-forward data rather than a genuinely stable distribution.
strings.t: Tout kat bann GPA yo idantik jiska santyèm nan atravè tab Klas 2024 ak Klas 2025 yo. Yon matche egzak nan kat bann atravè de gwoup diferan pa gen anpil chans sou plan estatistik, kidonk sa ka done yo pote annavan olye ke yon distribisyon ki vrèman estab.

strings.text: No gap-year statistic, policy or counselling service is described anywhere — and since 98% four-year plus 2% two-year accounts for the whole class, the published outcomes leave no room for a gap-year cohort at all.

strings.text: A rigorous, legible academic product with an unusually heavy counselor caseload — and disclosure that is excellent about outcomes, silent about process.
strings.t: Yon pwodwi akademik rigoure, lizib ak yon chay konseye ki lou yon fason ki pa abityèl — epi divilgasyon ki ekselan sou rezilta, an silans sou pwosesis.

strings.text: How does one director manage 85 seniors at peak season — what does the junior spring / senior fall calendar actually look like?
